title: uTest Academy — free software-testing training (possible path to paid testing)
notes: Candidate only, not a verified open paid job. Official uTest support says there is no membership fee and the Academy is free. Possible paid work is conditional on invitations/eligibility and approved tasks; payout varies by project. uTest requires testers to be 18+ and requires a real name; sign-up also asks for personal/profile and device details. Consider only if comfortable providing required details privately to uTest. Never put private identity or payment information in this public repository or tracker. No earnings or invitations guaranteed.
